The '''Baes Logia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located within the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baes Logia]].
